Three portraits for `tests/model.rs`: two different people, the second one twice. Each is the uploaded original from Wikimedia Commons,
marked Public domain on its Commons page (official portraits of US federal officials); the same files are rows of `../eval/faces.tsv`
(`p05_1`, `p14_1`, `p14_6`), which has the Commons page id and licence of each (the file is looked up by page id; no names are kept in the repository).
